macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩, if \gtrifleaf and \gtrifchild are both true, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: gtrifleafparent
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩, if \gtrifleaf and \gtrifparent are both true, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: gtrifmale
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩, if \gtrDBsex holds male, and to ⟨false⟩ otherwise.

macros.name: gtrifnativitydefined

macros.name: gtrifnodeid

macros.name: gtrifparent

macros.name: gtrifplacedefined

macros.name: gtrifpnode

macros.name: gtrifprofessiondefined

macros.name: gtrifroot

macros.name: gtrifwedlockdefined
macros.doc: Expands to ⟨true⟩ if at least one of the events /gtr/database/marriage, /gtr/database/engagement, or /gtr/database/divorce is defined; otherwise, it expands to ⟨false⟩.
